about:
Founded in 1982 in Paterson, New Jersey, Bennett Plastics is a family-owned and operated custom plastic injection molding company. Located just minutes from New York City, the business began as a local manufacturer and has grown to serve customers nationwide from its 36,000-square-foot facility.

The company provides a full range of in-house services including custom plastic injection molding, 3D printing and prototyping, product development and design for manufacturing, injection mold making, and finishing and packaging. Its Paterson facility produces millions of parts annually, supported by a team of experienced professionals across operations, engineering, quality, and production.

Bennett Plastics serves diverse industries such as baby products, food service, consumer goods, health and beauty, electrical, industrial products, and pharmaceutical. The company works with clients from initial concept through full-scale production, tailoring solutions to each sector's requirements.

The company differentiates itself by keeping all manufacturing on-site with no outsourcing, enabling direct communication, strict quality control, and fast delivery. Its Fast-Track Mold Insert Program can deliver molded samples in as little as five weeks. A zero-defects quality objective, adherence to OSHA and Good Manufacturing Practices, and a sustainability focus using eco-friendly materials and waste reduction further define its approach.
